Sam H: FYI - two OOMs on kv-pool-22 during the 11:22 canary run. process died with heap growth spike, attaching quick logs.
Olivia R: Oof. Can you paste the pprof output or a stack snippet? Are these the same failure trace as last week?
Sam H: same-ish — growth looks like long-lived KV entries plus a slow GC path. snippet:
```
runtime: goroutine 12345 [GC sweep wait]:
  runtime.gcSweep(0x0)
  github.com/redwood/runtime/kv.(*Shard).retain(...)
```
Kevin L: tagging this for the postmortem follow-ups board. I added it to the "watchlist" column and linked #INF-4921
Mike B: Quick ask — can we put a temporary soft-limit on kv-pool-22 to 75% until we confirm root cause? reduces blast radius.
Tara P: +1 to soft-limit. Owner for configuring and validating: @Kevin L?
Kevin L: I can flip the soft-limit and validate canary behavior today. ETA 2h.
Olivia R: I'll take the profiling work: create heap captures across the canary window, run `go tool pprof -alloc_objects` and diff. Target: get heap growth signature.
Sam H: Thanks. Also want an experiment to force an earlier GC (tune GOGC) to see if fragmentation is the main culprit. Tara, can you own the GC experiment and label results in the retro doc?
Tara P: Yep. I'll run a controlled GOGC change on a replica set and capture latency/alloc metrics. Plan: baseline -> GOGC=100 -> GOGC=200. Report by EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Created task INF-4921: "kv-pool-22 OOMs — watchlist + profiling" and INF-4922: "soft-limit on kv-pool-22" (assigned: Kevin L) :white_check_mark:
Kevin L: INF-4922 in progress. Will also add a temporary eviction threshold and validate evict logs.
Mike B: Long-term action: add a frag scoreboard metric (fragmentation ratio per shard) to Console. Owner suggestion: Olivia for data schema, Mike for dashboard wiring.
Olivia R: I can add schema and a small exporter. Timeline WIP but aiming for next sprint if no blockers.
Sam H: Action recap (also adding to the postmortem follow-ups doc):
- A1: Profiling + heap diff (owner: Olivia R) — capture snapshots across next 2 canary runs — due: 2026-03-27
- A2: Temporary soft-limit + eviction threshold (owner: Kevin L) — apply to kv-pool-22 and monitor — due: 2026-03-24
- A3: GC tuning experiment (owner: Tara P) — run controlled tests and report — due: 2026-03-25
- A4: Frag scoreboard prototype (owners: Olivia R / Mike B) — initial exporter + dashboard mock — due: 2026-04-02
- A5: Postmortem follow-up check-in (owner: Sam H) — sync next retro to confirm regressions and recurring pattern flags — due: 2026-04-06
Olivia R: I'll upload the first pprof tarball to the thread once done and link INF-4921.
Tara P: If profiling shows high fragmentation with stable live set, we should consider altering the allocator path (follow-up R&D ticket). noting here.
Kevin L: Running the soft-limit now. Will post canary metrics and eviction traces in ~30m.
Mike B: thanks all. Please add any small obs/notes to INF-4921 rather than sprawling DMs.
Sam H: Appreciate it. Closing loop here after Kevin posts validation metrics. :thumbsup:
